messages:
maya: Quick debrief from this morning — we observed two coupled failures: cloud metadata API rate spikes that caused auth token refreshes to fail, and the model-registry returning intermittent 503s during rolling deploys. Impact was ~4-7m flaps for inference and failed model uploads.

alex: Acknowledged. I'll own the client-side mitigations: increase backoff with exponential + jitter, and add a short client-side circuit breaker for metadata endpoint. Planning to open a PR today; target: EOD Friday for rollout.

jihoon: I'll take the model-registry side. Proposal: add a read-only S3-backed mirror for manifests and a cached degraded-path that serves last-known-good manifests when registry is unreachable. Prototype ETA: Tue next week.

maya: Please include explicit runbook steps for oncall to flip to the mirror and to pin a fallback model version. Keep commands simple.

alex: Adding runbook entries now. Example quick command I'm prototyping:
```
# trigger client backoff reload
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/api/clients/reload-backoff -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_KEY"
```
Reversible and limited to client pool.

tara: SRE wants a short-term edge-side mitigation too. I'll add 429 handling and a fast-acting circuit flag at the service edge so we can throttle outbound bursts to vendor endpoints. Timeline: 24h.

jihoon: For the registry TTLs — current 60s caused stampedes during failover. Recommend 300s + randomized jitter and a warm-up of mirror cache on deploys. Also need a degradation policy doc.

sre-lead: Agree on TTL bump. Also add an alert: token refresh error rate > 5% at p95 for 5m. That should surface this earlier.

incident-bot: Runbook created — https://internal.redwood/runbooks/outage-2691234567 (owners: alex, jihoon, tara) :white_check_mark:

maya: Action item summary (please update with PR/Issue links and completion dates):
- alex: client backoff + runbook command (EOD Fri)
- tara: 429 handler + edge circuit feature flag (24h)
- jihoon: registry read-only mirror prototype + TTL bump (prototype Tue)
- sre-lead: alert + dashboard panel (48h)

alex: I'll attach a canary plan to the PR and include rollback steps.

tara: Planning a 10-min drill with oncall tomorrow morning to exercise flipping to mirror and the runbook. I'll coordinate.

jihoon: Also recommending a vendor SLO verification and escalation contact list — vendor auth endpoint had a hidden rate-limit. We should add contractual SLO checks and a direct escalation path.

maya: Agree. I'll own vendor contact updates and a quarterly verification task.

alex: I'll add dependency tags to the incident tracker (cloud-metadata, model-registry, vendor-auth) so we can aggregate patterns.

sre-lead: I'll add a recurring monthly verification on the reliability board to spot vendor outage patterns and ensure follow-ups are complete.

maya: Let's reconvene next Wed in the post-incident review slot with PR links and drill results. If anything blocks owners before then, post here or DM me. :thumbsup:
